title: Center of Gravity
text: For efficient bipedal walking, the body's center of gravity must be positioned directly over the supporting legs. Consider what shape the spine would need to achieve this positioning.

title: Comparing Spines
text: Great apes have a more C-shaped spine. Humans have evolved a spine with multiple curves - one in the neck region (cervical), one in the upper back (thoracic), one in the lower back (lumbar), and one at the sacrum. Together, these form a distinctive letter shape.
